Row.Text: Xi Jinping is the historical leader of China.
Greece represents the western reaches of the ancient trade networks that connected China with the Mediterranean world.
Rome represents a powerful centralized state and the western terminus of the great Eurasian trade routes that connected the Mediterranean world with China.
Mongolia represents China's deep geographic and historical connections with the peoples of Inner Asia and the Eurasian steppe.
Norman represents strong state-building, economic ambition, and the projection of influence beyond its traditional borders.
